value.rationale: A nonempty, model-wide sign-reversal region demonstrates precisely when increasing environmental switching makes the expected ecological population grow while almost every realization declines. The exact sharp frontier and strict all-rational exponent certificate offer a reproducible, mathematically motivated benchmark for the gap between ensemble and pathwise persistence, beyond a mere illustration of Jensen inequality. The biological interpretation is limited to linear cross-recruitment dynamics.
